near_vacuum.note: GATE = |sum(c_plasma)|_nearvac / |sum(c_plasma)|_flattop (ABSOLUTE net toroidal current) at the selected (order, lambda); <= tol_frac. The 0.99 plasma/passive collinearity is NOT separable within the locked lambda ceiling, so near-vacuum c_plasma is NOT driven to ~0 (net current stays ~kA-scale). References only raw |Ip|, never labels.
near_vacuum.absolute_current_caveat: near_vacuum_ok reflects the RELATIVE net-current ratio (median 0.030 <= 0.25). But the ABSOLUTE inferred net plasma current at near-vacuum is ~19372 A (median) while measured |Ip| there is ~0 (a few A): c_plasma is NOT literally driven to 0. The plasma/passive Green blocks are 0.99-collinear, so the locked lambda ceiling (0.1, trace-matched = 10% of the data term) cannot separate them; the absolute near-vacuum plasma current only collapses at lambda>=10 (outside the locked grid). The regulariser is sound in the relative sense but the instrument cannot cleanly attribute field to plasma-vs-passive within the locked grid.

fail_reasons: no label set both beats the trivial |dB/dt|/B-var baseline (+0.02 AUROC) AND survives the eddy ablation

pass_criterion: written BEFORE the run: PASS iff operating point sanity-selected AND near-vacuum-sound AND >=1 label set beats best trivial |dB/dt|/B-var baseline by >=+0.02 AUROC AND survives eddy ablation. Primary statistic = absolute ||W(pred-raw)||; verdict invariant under the fractional statistic too.
